text:
Sam K: Heads-up — last night around 02:10 UTC we had a cascade: multiple AppSets tried to reconcile at the same time and ended up evicting pods from gpu-pool-us-west-1. Seeing repeated helm hook failures and ArgoCD lock/lease errors. Anyone digging in?
SRE Bot: Alert: argocd-controller spikes (reconcile failures 85 events in 10m). Sample error: 
```
E0305 02:11:03.123 argocd] failed to acquire lock: resource lease busy (ttl expired)
E0305 02:11:03.456 controller] appset-controller: reconcile timeout
```
Alex M: Confirmed — CI ran three parallel promo pipelines that targeted the same appset group. CI jobs all pushed new image tags within 20s. That probably caused the controller to attempt concurrent syncs.
Priya S: The AppSet's "syncStrategy.lockTTL" is default (30s). When multiple child apps get created at once the controller races to grab the lock and we see retries + helm presync hooks timing out. Suggest increasing lockTTL and also enabling per-app partitioning.
Matt R: Workaround rolled out: paused auto-reconciles for the top 2 appsets while we backfill. Commands used:
```
kubectl -n argocd patch appset my-appset --type merge -p '{"spec":{"generators":[{"list":{"elements":[]}}]}}'
# (or temporarily set syncPolicy.syncWindow to block)
```
Alex M: Also scaled argocd-controller from 3 -> 6 replicas and bumped controller CPU to avoid controller-worker starvation. That dropped immediate failure rate.
Priya S: GPU side: autoscaler log shows backoff when provisioning spot GPUs due to quota checks: "Exceeded quota: GPUs in project". gpu-pool-us-west-1 at 98% committed. We had several eviction events for low-priority pods.
SRE Bot: Metric snapshot (02:12): gpu_pool_us_west_1_capacity=64, used=63, pending_creates=8, autoscaler_backoff=true
Sam K: Ok — plan proposal: 1) increase appset lockTTL to 90s, 2) enable AppSet "parallelism" to 3, 3) stagger CI deploys by 30s jitter, 4) add a small standby preemptible GPU pool for burst (autoscaler priority low). Thoughts?
Matt R: +1. Also add a Helm hook timeout bump for presync hooks so they don't get killed during transient controller contention. Example in Chart: 
```
annotations:
  "helm.sh/hook-delete-policy": "before-hook-creation"
  "helm.sh/hook-weight": "0"
  "helm.sh/hook-timeout": "300"
```
ArgoCD Bot: Noted patch: argocd appset/my-appset sync paused by @Matt R at 02:18 UTC. Pending manual reconcile.
Priya S: Cost note: standby preemptible pool (8xA10g-preemptible) estimated +~$3.2k/month but avoids customer impact and reduces chattiness on the autoscaler. Recommend opt-in for peak hours only.
Alex M: I'll add jitter to the CI pipelines (simple sleep RANDOM(0-30)). Also adding a gate that prevents >2 concurrent pipeline runs targeting same appset.
Sam K: OK — implement changes in staging first. I'll follow up with a short runbook: what to do if lock/lease errors reappear. Thanks all :thumbsup:
